text:
frank: quick UX sync — found a couple of annoying edge cases in the roles matrix + invite drawer around SSO, copy, and audit nav. sharing notes from the lab.
lina: pls list repros so eng can pick them up.
frank: 1) when drawer open + toggle SSO fast, focus sometimes jumps to the audit breadcrumb. 2) role chips in compact mode have too-small hit targets and focus rings overlap on high-contrast themes. 3) copy on the SSO control says "Enforce SSO" which confused support and test participants.
devon: thanks. sounds familiar to other threads but here's what I'd propose: a) move the per-invite SSO toggle into the drawer (discoverable during invite) but keep an org-default setting on the main settings page. b) ensure drawer focus-lock is re-evaluated after any DOM update (focusLock.update()). c) remove programmatic focus from breadcrumb updates; use aria-live for announcements.
aria: accessibility checklist additions: - aria-describedby linking toggle -> helper text - role=status live region for invite success/errors - when removing a role chip set tabindex=-1 immediately then remove from DOM - respect prefers-reduced-motion for chip animations
lina: copy proposal for helper: short: "Require SSO for new users. Learn more." longer: "Require company SSO for invited users so new accounts authenticate through your identity provider." which should we ship?
devon: ship the short one in the drawer; longer text on the org-settings page. wire a "Learn more" to docs.
frank: design micro-asks: 1) add an "Esc to close" hint in drawer header, 2) increase chip horizontal padding by 4px in compact mode, 3) add a 2px forced-colors outline for high-contrast. lina can you drop a tiny figma slice?
lina: yes will add figma slice + token for focus outline color.
aria: QA will add a Puppeteer keyboard test: open drawer, rapid toggle SSO, tab through — assert focus stays inside drawer and never lands on breadcrumb or header. also add a high-contrast visual test for chips.
devon: note for implementation: when toggling SSO we sometimes re-render a parent component that triggers breadcrumb autofocus. guard that code path: if (drawerOpen) skipFocusOnBreadcrumbUpdate = true.
ops-bot: created ticket INV-5124: "Invite drawer - focus retention + SSO copy + chip a11y" assigned to @devon, @lina, @aria.
frank: target: small CSS + copy patch this sprint; focus-lock update + tests next sprint. thanks team :thumbsup:
